fields.title: Input
fields.description: Choose input file here. You can also provide an arbitrary URL here (such as http:// or ftp://).

fields.title: Separator Char
fields.description: Enter character separating entries in the table (for instance space, comma or semicolon). Consecutive separator characters will result in errors.

fields.title: Missing value pattern
fields.description: Pattern for missing values in the file.

fields.title: Read Row Header
fields.description: Check this when the file contains row header information (names of rows)

fields.title: Read Column Header
fields.description: Check this when the file contains column header information (will skip the first line then). If the "Read Row Header" option is on, the file is supposed to contain a place holder identifier in the upper left corner. That is, it must not immediately start with the first column name but some (ignored) row header column identifier.

fields.title: Matrix Type
fields.description: Select whether the file contains a full matrix or a triangular matrix.

fields.title: Matrix is symmetric
fields.description: Select this if the table contains the full matrix but the matrix is symmetric (i.e. the value at location (m,n) is equal to the value at (n,m)). Selecting this option will reduce the memory footprint since only the lower triangular matrix is read.

fields.title: Contains Diagonal
fields.description: Each row contains the self-distance of the respective row as first element, which is supposed to be 0.0 after normalization (if it is not a warning is printed).

fields.title: Apply linear transformation
fields.description: The values in the file should be linearly transformed by a given scale and offset value (whereby the scale operation precedes the offset operation, the new distance value is y = scale * x + offset). If the file contains similarity values, select offset = 1.0 and scale = -1.0.

fields.title: Offset
fields.description: The offset value for the linear transformation.

fields.title: Scale
fields.description: The scale value for the linear transformation.
